subject: INITIATE statement
notes: kb/Work PB369. Rule text (cite.py --check 14.9.21.3 "the file description entry associated with report-name-1 shall contain a GLOBAL clause" -> OK, SR 2). A contained program's INITIATE of a container's GLOBAL report whose FD is not GLOBAL is refused COBOL2392 (RejectContainedReportFile, shared with GENERATE and TERMINATE); a non-GLOBAL report of a container is not visible at all (13.18.27.4 GR2) and draws SR1's 'shall be defined by a report description entry'.
